name: Blue Grants Fund

funder.name: Seychelles Conservation and Climate Adaptation Trust (SeyCCAT)

summary: Annual grant round for Seychellois-led projects in marine conservation, habitat rehabilitation, sustainable fisheries and blue-economy work, with small, medium and large grant sizes. Overseas-based applicants are not eligible.

amount.note: Small grants up to SCR 100,000, medium up to 1 million, large up to 2 million

geography.quote: The Blue Grants Fund (BGF) provides funding to innovative Seychellois-led projects that advance marine conservation, sustainable fisheries, and other key areas within the blue economy sector.
